# VD-06 Micro metal gearmotors

This page is an excerpt of data that the vendors themselves publish (product pages, datasheets, drawings): one
vendor's line of micro metal gearmotors, every winding and every gear ratio of the line. The values are the vendors'
own, in the vendors' units; nothing is converted. "not published" marks a value that the vendor pages used for this
excerpt do not state. The page sets comparable parts side by side; it does not say which of them, if any, is on the
robot.

## Pololu: common to the line

| field | value |
|---|---|
| gearbox cross-section | 10 x 12 mm |
| output shaft | 9 mm long, 3 mm diameter, D-shaped |
| the gearbox with the highest ratio of the line is longer by | 3.5 mm |
| the encoder extends beyond the motor, on the connector side, by | 3 mm or 4 mm |
| extended motor shaft | 1 mm diameter, extends 4.5 mm |
| encoder resolution | 12 counts per revolution of the motor shaft |
| encoder connector | 6-pin JST SH-style male connector |
| encoder connector orientations | Back Connector (parallel to the motor) / Side Connector (perpendicular to the motor) |
| encoder supply, minimum | 2.7 V |
| encoder supply, maximum | 18 V |
| pull-ups on the encoder outputs | 10 kohm |
| note on the dimension drawings | The versions with carbon brushes (HPCB) have slightly different terminal and end-cap dimensions than the versions with precious metal brushes |

## Pololu: encoder connector

| pin | wire colour | function |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Green | encoder GND |
| 2 | White | encoder channel B output |
| 3 | Yellow | encoder channel A output |
| 4 | Blue | encoder Vcc (2.7 V to 18 V) |
| 5 | Black | motor power M2 (other terminal) |
| 6 | Red | motor power M1 ("+" terminal) |
